svg.text: DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Production Readiness Audit: 10 Non-LLM Controls Every Agent Needs Before It Touches Real Systems
Example audit of a reference agent — each row names the Google Cloud and open-source enforcement; failing controls blink until fixed.
sha256(tool+args) dedupe in Firestore or Redis; 3rd
recursion_limit; cost via Billing budget or LiteLLM
tool outputs -> GCS or MinIO URIs
Index 85 MCP schemas in AlloyDB pgvector or Qdrant;
Snapshot after every tool turn: Firestore, LangGraph
Claims bound to git blob SHA (Firestore / PostgreSQL
/ Mem0); O(1) staleness check on read
Model Armor or Llama Guard / NeMo Guardrails scan;
Cloud Build or GitHub Actions blocks prompt edits
unless 100% of Promptfoo / Inspect fixtures pass
Export the last 50 production trajectories as
Promptfoo fixtures; fail CI (Cloud Build or GitHub
Embed MCP tool cards in AlloyDB pgvector or
Qdrant; mount Top-3 per step; expect -93% schema
Store (file, lines, blob_sha) with every claim in
Firestore or PostgreSQL / Mem0; flag STALE on
Ship only when every FAIL is closed; PARTIAL controls need a dated owner. Re-audit after each prompt, tool-schema, or framework-version change.
